title: Chinese military researchers tap US AI models to train defense systems
description: Chinese researchers have reportedly used leading U.S. AI models developed by OpenAI and Anthropic to train AI systems to advance defense capabilities.

title: The arms race for cheaper anti-ballistic weapons is underway
description: After years of a Patriot monopoly, new anti-ballistic alternatives are emerging. Officials hope to see some of them on the battlefield by the end of 2026.

title: F-47 program producing test aircraft, on schedule for 2028 flight
description: The F-47 program has begun its engineering and manufacturing phase and will fly during this presidential administration, a service official said.

title: Navy awards $76.6 billion for Virginia, Columbia-class submarines
description: The U.S. Navy is spending $76.6 billion to build five Columbia-class and nine Virginia-class submarines.

title: Iran war depleted US Patriot missile stockpiles, creating readiness challenges, experts say
description: The U.S. has depleted roughly two-thirds of its pre-war Patriot missile interceptor inventory during the conflict with Iran, new analysis says.

title: Iran to get Chinese shoulder-launched missile systems in weeks, sources say
description: Iran is expected to receive within weeks a first shipment out of up to 400 Chinese-made shoulder-fired air defense missile launchers.

title: US strikes $58.6 billion Patriot missile deal amid rising stockpile concerns
description: The U.S. Army awarded Lockheed Martin a contract worth up to $58.6 billion to produce Patriot interceptor missiles.

title: DARPA challenge pushes limits of heavy-lift drone technology
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency next week will kick off its inaugural Lift Challenge next week. The agency will award $6.5 million in prizes.

title: Ukraine’s F-16s are being worn out from intercepting Russian drones
description: Ukrainian F-16s have destroyed more than 2,500 one-way attack drones, but repeated interceptions are wearing out the country's small fleet.

title: Pentagon puts out call for robot boats that launch attack drones
description: The Pentagon has put out a solicitation for drone boats that can launch attack drones — and it wants them ready to test within 120 days.

title: Pentagon has ‘kicked off’ review of US force posture in Europe
description: The review follows repeated calls by Trump administration officials for European allies to assume greater responsibility for NATO’s conventional defense.

title: US Navy deploys GARC uncrewed surface vessel in first live-fire training exercise
description: The Navy confirmed its first live-fire training exercise of its Global Autonomous Reconnaissance Craft uncrewed surface vessel.

title: US Marine Corps welcomes delivery of final MV-22B Osprey
description: The MV-22 Osprey began its last chapter in the Marine Corps on Tuesday with the delivery of the 359th — and final — model.

title: Ford, GM Defense, BC Customs to compete for US Army’s new infantry squad vehicle
description: Ford, GM Defense and BC Customs will build competing prototypes of the U.S. Army's future infantry squad vehicle.

title: House-passed defense bill includes controversial US-Israel tech measure
description: The House-passed defense bill includes a measure to encourage co-development and co-production between the U.S. and Israeli defense industrial bases.

title: Trump, Zelenskyy discuss Patriot deal and reviving talks with Russia
description: Zelenskyy later told Fox News’ “Hannity” show that Trump had “accepted that he will give us licenses” to produce the Patriot interceptors.

title: El Nino is a threat indicator. The military should treat it like one.
description: The weather forecast for the second half of 2026 is giving the DoD something commanders rarely get before disruption arrives: months of notice.

title: First Anduril YFQ-44A rolls off production line for US CCA program
description: Anduril's Ohio-based facility produced its first YFQ-44A, an unmanned, semi-autonomous aircraft, on Monday.

title: US Central Command, UAE to launch artificial intelligence task force
description: CENTCOM and the UAE will establish Task Force Talon Synapse aimed at boosting the development of military artificial intelligence applications.

title: Finland closes airspace, restricts maritime traffic near Russia over drone risk
description: Finland’s military said it closed a section of Finnish airspace and restricted maritime traffic off the country’s southern coast near the Russian border.

title: French wildfires threaten nuclear deterrence industry, Rafale assembly
description: Wildfires raging west of the French city of Bordeaux are threatening a number of France’s key defense-industrial sites.

title: Pentagon calls for cheaper long-range strike weapons, with testing in just 3 months
description: The Pentagon is seeking long-range weapons that cost less than $250,000 each and can be ready for demonstration within three months.

title: Austria plans to extend military service in light of Ukraine war
description: Austria’s coalition government plans to extend military service to nine months from six.

description: A recent interceptor test marked the first demonstration of New Delhi’s efforts to build a system that could rival the Russian-made S-400.

description: The positive vote came despite persistent concerns from FDA scientists and positions the company to bounce back from two earlier rejections.

title: Alnylam plunges as earnings deliver ‘one-two punch’
description: The RNA-focused biotech shed 30% of its market value — or close to $12 billion — amid growing investor concerns about its main drug business.

title: FTC sues Hims & Hers over alleged privacy violations, deceptive billing practices
description: Regulators say the telehealth company illegally shared patients’ health data with advertisers and misled its customers. Hims & Hers hit back, calling the claims “baseless.”

title: J&J nabs option to buy ‘in vivo’ CAR-T maker Sail for nearly $2.6B
description: The deal with the buzzy Flagship Pioneering-backed startup makes J&J the latest large drugmaker to bet that the technology might be able to treat autoimmune conditions.

title: Capricor Duchenne cell therapy voted down by FDA panel
description: At a contentious meeting with possible implications for other rare disease drugmakers, outside experts ultimately determined that Capricor didn't prove deramiocel's benefits in Duchenne-related cardiomyopathy.

title: MapLight CEO on what investors missed in the biotech’s schizophrenia data
description: Though positive, mid-stage study results erased about two-thirds of the biotech's market value this week. But Christopher Kroeger sees MapLight's drug as competitive based on the "totality of data."

title: Caldera, Vidya add to recent flurry of biotech mergers
description: The startups are part of a surge of young companies equipped with advanced drug prospects and quickly pivoting to the public markets.

title: AbCellera, Vertex partner on next-gen T-cell engagers
description: The deal adds to a growing streak of partnerships involving new types of T cell engagers and gives Vertex another chance to broaden a business still reliant on cystic fibrosis medicines.
